officialViewerConfiguration.observedSchema: Level lists return code, value and hasData metadata. Extent route returns xmin/ymin/xmax/ymax, attribution and gisCode. No parcel feature schema was observed.

registryEvidence: The Government of Uttar Pradesh BhuNaksha/Bhulekh portals and Revenue Council page evidence the state cadastral map/land-record service and Sikandrabad administrative selection. This is registry/service custody evidence only, not parcel-source admission or ownership evidence.
